description: Route risk between two ports (UN/LOCODEs): a 0–100 score, risk level, the signals driving it (war-risk areas, piracy, chokepoints, weather, sanctions exposure of transited EEZs), sea days, confidence and any missing sources. On lanes that can go either way round Africa it also scores the other passage (Suez or Cape) in `alternatives`. Resolve port names with find_port first. Needs ARCNAUTICAL_API_KEY; see get_usage for the allowance.

customer_reference.description: Your own reference (voyage id, fixture); echoed on the assessment

dwt_tonnes.description: Deadweight in tonnes; accepted, but it does not change the score today

load_condition.description: laden or ballast; affects exposure on the transit (with vessel_type)

passage.description: Which way round Africa to score: shortest (default; Suez on Asia-Europe), suez or cape. Refused on lanes with no such passage

speed_knots.description: Planned service speed, 8-25 knots; sets route.transit_days (default 14), and with vessel_type times the weather

vessel_type.description: Vessel class; changes which threat signals weigh most (default: general)

name: score_voyage

missing_sources.description: Signals that could not be read for this assessment

title: Score a voyage route (API key)
